messages:
ella (people-ops): FYI we have a late contractor->FTE conversion. Offer effective = 2026-05-01 but HR paperwork received 2026-05-11. Need guidance on backpay + benefits enrollment.

sam (manager): They were onboarded as FTE on offer date from a headcount perspective. What CSV rows do you need for retro?

payroll-bot: Payroll bot: US retro import cutoff = 2026-05-20 23:59 UTC. Use sftp://payroll-uploads/us/retro/. Validation report posted to #payroll-ops.

nina (payroll): Send two rows: one retro_gross with period_start=2026-05-01 period_end=2026-05-10 amount=NUMERIC, and one set_salary with effective_date=2026-05-11 new_annual=XXXXX. If sign-on or one-time bonus, add separate one_time row.

sam (manager): Do I include contractor final hours in the same file?

nina (payroll): Nocontractor final payout goes to AP. Add note "contractor_final_to_AP:true" so payroll won't try to process contractor AP items.

compops-bot: CompOps bot: for equity/vesting, open a CompOps ticket with employee_id and offer doc. Equity is handled outside payroll.

ella (people-ops): Benefits question: can we retro-enroll employee to start 5/1 even though paperwork came in 5/11?

nina (payroll): US: yes within 30 days we can retro-enroll and bill employer contributions from 5/1. For UK/APAC check local benefits admins; some vendors disallow retro employer payments. If disallowed, we may issue a one-time employer-side payment.

sam (manager): Thanks. Action: I'll prepare CSV with retro_gross and set_salary rows, tag contractor AP separately, and open a CompOps ticket. Will upload before cutoff.

ella (people-ops): Thanks team. Ping me if payroll validation flags any rows. :white_check_mark:
